Which shortwave stations broadcast in Romanian?

In the A-26 schedule, 3 stations broadcast in Romanian. The most heavily scheduled include Radio Romania International, China Radio International, Radio Vaticana.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts in Romanian?

The most-used frequencies are 9500, 11975, 6090, 11945, 15170 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
